what: Forbidden-path guard is not pinned to the pre-tier snapshot
scenario_or_breakage: If a conflict fixer edits .gitmodules and a submodule path, computing forbidden paths after launch can omit the original submodule path; the stall branch can also leave non-conflict deltas because the plan only resets conflict paths
suggested_fix: Capture forbidden paths and the tier baseline before each tier launch; on any forbidden touch, revert with that snapshot, revert the tier delta back to baseline, reset conflicts, then raise Stalled without handoff

what: [OUT_OF_SCOPE] Agentic timeout recovery can trust a stale push checkpoint
scenario_or_breakage: A previous delegate writes ci-agentic-push-checkpoint.latest; a later delegate in the same tmpdir times out before its first push; the parent reports pushed or rebase pending from the old run
suggested_fix: Track a follow-up to unlink the checkpoint before launch or include the current run id or nonce in the checkpoint and validate it before timeout recovery
